bibl.title: Beads and pendants from the Hellenistic to early Byzantine Red Sea port of Berenike, Egypt. Season 2014 and 2015.
bibl.seg: Joanna Then-Obłuska, Beads and pendants from the Hellenistic to early Byzantine Red Sea port of Berenike, Egypt. Season 2014 and 2015.
Polish Archaeology in the Mediterranean. 26/1. Research (Warsaw, 2017) pp. 203-234, figg.
bibl.note: During the 2014 and 2015 excavation seasons at Berenike almost 650 beads and pendants were recorded. - Hellenistic trash dump. - Hellenistic urban fortifications. - Early Roman burials. - Early Roman trash dump. - Early Roman animal cemetery. - Early Roman harbor. - Late Roman temenos. - The great temple. - Western complex. - Northern architectural complex. - Late trash dump. - Summary.
